_note: agents/social-poster. posts_per_day caps how many approved items START posting per UTC day; a retry of a platform that failed never counts against it. cron_utc must match DAILY_SOCIAL_POSTER in scripts/setup-cron.sh (pinned by a test). Cron is UTC-only on the server. Three a week (Mon/Wed/Fri) since 2026-11-03: at three a day reach per post fell from ~20 to ~6.
_repeatNote: An approved item whose headline (case and punctuation ignored) already posted on any platform inside this many days waits; items with a new headline go first. At three a day the same headline went up as many as 6 times in a week.
_organicNote: organic_first: once any organic post (agents/social-organic: carousel, review card, relatable text post) has been approved, ad-batch images stop posting organically (Sean, 2026-11-04). Organic posts rotate by kind.
